verified_facts.text: The hotel is a historic palazzo dating back to the 18th century.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has been a member of The Leading Hotels of the World since 1990.

verified_facts.text: The vaulted ceiling of the I Carracci restaurant is entirely frescoed by the school of the Carracci brothers.
verified_facts.excerpt: The vaulted ceiling, entirely frescoed by the school of the Carracci brothers — one of the highest expressions of 16th-century painting

verified_facts.text: The hotel's historic wine cellar is known today as Enoteca Morandi, in homage to the Bolognese painter Giorgio Morandi.
verified_facts.excerpt: The historic wine cellar of the Grand Hotel Majestic “già Baglioni”, it is known today as Enoteca Morandi, in homage to one of the most important Bolognese painters of the 20th century, Giorgio Morandi.

verified_facts.text: The Enoteca Wine Bar hosts wine and food tastings with the hotel's sommelier.
verified_facts.excerpt: is the ideal location for wine and food tastings with our sommelier

verified_facts.text: The Terrazza Torre and Terrazza Foyer terraces are on the piano nobile, reserved for the suites; the Terrazza Torre overlooks Palazzo Fava.
verified_facts.excerpt: Located on the piano nobile, reserved for the suites, the Terrazza Torre - overlooking Palazzo Fava - and the Terrazza Foyer offer an intimate and discreet atmosphere.

verified_facts.text: The terraces can be booked for drinks or light snacks, with a fee for the dedicated service.
verified_facts.excerpt: The terraces can be booked for drinks or light snacks, with a fee for the dedicated service.

verified_facts.text: The Café Marinetti floor was made by Tuscan artisans in Art Deco style using Statuario, Nero Marquinia and Giallo Siena marbles from Carrara.
verified_facts.excerpt: The flooring, a genuine work of art, was made by Tuscan artisans in Art Deco style, using precious Statuario, Nero Marquinia and Giallo Siena marbles from Carrara.

verified_facts.text: The hotel offers cooking classes dedicated to handmade fresh pasta, guided by the hotel's chef.
verified_facts.excerpt: our cooking classes dedicated to handmade fresh pasta. Under the expert guidance of our Chef

verified_facts.text: The Lost Perfume experience explores a historic fragrance born in 1827, beginning inside the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: discover a historic fragrance born in 1827 and recently brought to light by its original formulas

verified_facts.text: Classic and Superior rooms are furnished in traditional Venetian style.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has seven meeting rooms: three historic in Venetian style with 16th-century decorations and chests, and four modern; all have natural light.
verified_facts.excerpt: the hotel now offers seven meeting rooms, of which three are historic — featuring the unmistakeable Venetian style and original decorations and chests from the 16th century — and four are modern. All rooms benefit from natural light
